name: lords-of-the-guild-monorepo
description: Lords of the Guild: jogo medieval de gerenciamento jogado no navegador, com aparência de editor

scripts.dev:up: docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --wait db db_test
scripts.dev:down: docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.dev.yml --profile full --profile tools down
scripts.db:psql: docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.dev.yml exec db psql -U lotg -d lotg
scripts.test:matrix: vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2 packages/sim-cli/src/balance.test.ts packages/engine/src/migrations.test.ts packages/sim-cli/src/matrix.test.ts packages/sim-cli/src/coverage.test.ts
scripts.test:guards: vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2 packages/engine/src/purity.test.ts packages/engine/src/fixtures.test.ts packages/engine/src/state.test.ts packages/engine/src/view.test.ts packages/content/src/content.test.ts packages/content/src/council.test.ts packages/content/src/expeditions.test.ts packages/protocol/src/protocol.test.ts packages/web/src/bundle.test.ts packages/web/src/tabs/tabs.test.tsx packages/landing/src/page.test.ts
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.verify:fast: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:fast
